headline: Nigeria Monthly Diaspora Remittances Hit $1 Billion Target, Eyes $1.5 Billion
summary: Remittance inflows to Nigeria through International Money Transfer Operators have reached $1 billion monthly, meeting the Central Bank of Nigeria's target as officials set a new $1.5 billion goal.
why: Diaspora remittances provide critical foreign exchange liquidity and support consumer spending and external stability in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Increased remittance inflows strengthen the country's foreign exchange reserves and economic stability.
